reading: People with different incomes told the BBC how the government's Budget, its plan for taxes and spending, could affect their finances.
Dave Herbert, a professional driver, says fuel prices have been extremely high this year.
He says his monthly petrol costs are around £350, between 40% and 50% higher than at the start of the year.
Dave was disappointed because the Budget did not include the cut in fuel duty, a tax on fuel, that he wanted.
Emily Nelson has been unable to find a job since leaving college last year.
She wants more funding for businesses so they can employ more young people, as well as more money for training.
Robert Portlock wants to leave his parents' home, but he does not think he can afford to live independently.
He says a small flat in his area would cost about two-thirds of his monthly wage in rent.
Chloe has cut back on luxuries, including cinema visits, and tries to keep her weekly food shopping within £40.
However, Chloe feels hopeful about the Budget because she believes small changes can help her.
She says cuts to standing charges, the fixed costs on gas bills, and a £100 energy payment will help her.
A higher earner wanted higher taxes for people with large incomes like his own, but says the Budget offered nothing on this.
He argues that better roads, hospitals and schools require more tax income.

vocabulary.definition: The money someone has and how they manage it.
A government tax included in the price of fuel.
Money provided to support an activity or purpose.
To have enough money to pay for something.
Money someone receives for doing their job.
To reduce how much you use, do or buy something.
Things or activities that are enjoyable but not necessary.
Fixed amounts charged for an energy supply, separate from the cost of the energy used.

entries.ja: ある人が持っているお金と、その管理の仕方。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람이 가진 돈과 그 돈을 관리하는 방식.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个人拥有的钱以及管理这些钱的方式。
entries.es: El dinero que tiene una persona y cómo lo administra.
entries.pt-BR: O dinheiro que uma pessoa tem e a maneira como o administra.
entries.fr: L’argent dont une personne dispose et la manière dont elle le gère.
entries.de: Das Geld, das jemand hat, und die Art, wie diese Person damit umgeht.

entries.ja: 燃料の価格に含まれている、政府が課す税金。
entries.ko: 정부가 부과하며 연료 가격에 포함되는 세금.
entries.zh-Hans: 政府征收并包含在燃料价格中的税款。
entries.es: Un impuesto del gobierno incluido en el precio del combustible.
entries.pt-BR: Um imposto do governo incluído no preço do combustível.
entries.fr: Une taxe imposée par le gouvernement et comprise dans le prix du carburant.
entries.de: Eine staatliche Steuer, die im Kraftstoffpreis enthalten ist.

entries.ja: 活動を支えたり、目的の達成を助けたりするために提供されるお金。
entries.ko: 활동이나 목적을 지원하기 위해 제공되는 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 为支持某项活动或某个目的而提供的资金。
entries.es: Dinero que se proporciona para apoyar una actividad o un propósito.
entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro fornecido para apoiar uma atividade ou uma finalidade.
entries.fr: De l’argent fourni pour soutenir une activité ou un objectif.
entries.de: Geld, das zur Unterstützung einer Tätigkeit oder eines Zwecks bereitgestellt wird.

entries.ja: 何かの代金を支払うのに十分なお金があること。
entries.ko: 무언가의 비용을 지불할 만큼 충분한 돈이 있다.
entries.zh-Hans: 有足够的钱支付某样东西的费用。
entries.es: Tener suficiente dinero para pagar algo.
entries.pt-BR: Ter dinheiro suficiente para pagar por algo.
entries.fr: Avoir assez d’argent pour payer quelque chose.
entries.de: Genug Geld haben, um etwas bezahlen zu können.

entries.ja: 仕事をすることで受け取るお金。
entries.zh-Hans: 一个人因从事工作而获得的钱。
entries.es: Dinero que una persona recibe por realizar su trabajo.
entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro que uma pessoa recebe pelo seu trabalho.
entries.fr: L’argent qu’une personne reçoit en échange de son travail.
entries.de: Geld, das jemand für seine Arbeit erhält.

entries.ja: 何かを使ったり、したり、買ったりする量や回数を減らすこと。
entries.ko: 무언가를 사용하거나 하거나 구매하는 양이나 횟수를 줄이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 减少使用或购买某物的数量，或减少从事某项活动的量或次数。
entries.es: Reducir la cantidad de algo que se usa o se compra, o cuánto se hace una actividad.
entries.pt-BR: Reduzir a quantidade de algo que se usa ou se compra, ou o quanto se faz uma atividade.
entries.fr: Réduire la quantité de quelque chose que l’on utilise ou achète, ou le temps ou la fréquence que l’on consacre à une activité.
entries.de: Weniger von etwas verwenden oder kaufen oder eine Tätigkeit in geringerem Umfang ausüben.

entries.ja: 楽しみを与えてくれるが、必要不可欠ではない物や活動。
entries.ko: 즐거움을 주지만 꼭 필요하지는 않은 물건이나 활동.
entries.zh-Hans: 令人愉快但并非必需的物品或活动。
entries.es: Cosas o actividades que se disfrutan, pero que no son necesarias.
entries.pt-BR: Coisas ou atividades que são agradáveis, mas não são necessárias.
entries.fr: Des choses ou des activités agréables, mais qui ne sont pas nécessaires.
entries.de: Dinge oder Aktivitäten, die Freude bereiten, aber nicht notwendig sind.

entries.ja: エネルギーの供給に対して請求される定額料金で、使用したエネルギーの料金とは別にかかるもの。
entries.ko: 에너지 공급에 대해 부과되는 고정 요금으로, 사용한 에너지 비용과는 별도로 청구되는 금액.
entries.zh-Hans: 为供应能源而收取的固定费用，与实际使用的能源费用分开计算。
entries.es: Importes fijos que se cobran por el suministro de energía, aparte del costo de la energía utilizada.
entries.pt-BR: Valores fixos cobrados pelo fornecimento de energia, separados do custo da energia utilizada.
entries.fr: Des montants fixes facturés pour la fourniture d’énergie, distincts du coût de l’énergie consommée.
entries.de: Feste Beträge, die für die Energieversorgung zusätzlich zu den Kosten der verbrauchten Energie berechnet werden.
